zh: 和 [ds-bot](https://github.com/Fei2411/DeepSeek-Bot) 同时安装时，两个插件不再抢同一个首页：以前 ds-bot 的 Bot 界面上叠着本主题的首页用量面板、权限档位与吉祥物，输入框被挤窄；切到 ds-bot 的经典 Agent 模式后，本主题的侧栏页脚又把 ds-bot 回到 Bot 界面的按钮收起来了。现在侧栏顶端有一个和 Claude 桌面端一样的聊天 / 代码切换：聊天是 ds-bot 的 Bot 界面，本主题整个让开，只留下这个切换；代码是宿主自己的界面，由本主题绘制。在聊天一侧刷新页面，本主题一帧也不会先画出来；用 ds-bot 自己的入口切换时，本主题同样跟上。桌面端切换在窗口顶端那一行、侧栏右端，网页上在侧栏第一行；没装 ds-bot 时页面上没有它。
en: With [ds-bot](https://github.com/Fei2411/DeepSeek-Bot) installed too, the two plugins no longer fight over one home page: ds-bot's Bot surface used to carry the theme's home usage panel, permission presets and mascot on top of it, with its composer squeezed narrow, and in ds-bot's classic Agent mode the theme's sidebar footer tucked away ds-bot's button back to its Bot surface. The top of the sidebar now carries a Chat / Code switch like the one in Claude's desktop app: Chat is ds-bot's Bot surface, and the theme steps aside entirely, leaving only the switch; Code is the host's own interface, painted by the theme. A reload on the Chat side never paints a frame of the theme first, and switching through ds-bot's own controls brings the theme along too. On the desktop the switch sits in the window's top row at the sidebar's right end, on the web in the sidebar's first row; without ds-bot the page carries none.
